fusions.name: Cloudburst
fusions.desc: Calls a downpour that deals 36 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Soaked] for 8 seconds. Your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds after it lands.

fusions.name: Skipping Drops
fusions.desc: Skips a drop of water that deals 8 damage, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Wet Feathers
fusions.desc: You regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Runoff
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health forms for 3 seconds; once every 8 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
